x-k-k7-07.goal: Judge which report keep real relationship between note facts, then pass contrast with correct connector.
x-k-k7-07.material:
Teacher note:

‘내일은 현장학습이에요. 버스가 8시에 떠나요. 늦으면 기다릴 수 없어요. 그러니까 7시 50분까지 오세요.’

Four students each pass note to friend wey ask ‘Why I must come by 7:50?’
x-k-k7-07.thinking.0: Read how facts relate (reason, contrast, condition)

x-k-k7-07.s.s1.r.b: You match 그러니까 with reason connector and keep background fact.
x-k-k7-07.s.s1.r.c: -아도 mean ‘even if’; note give reason, no be concession.
x-k-k7-07.s.s1.r.d: -면 come from 늦으면 in note, but dem attach am to wrong fact.
x-k-k7-07.s.s1.explain: Note say: field trip background, bus leave at 8 (reason), so arrive by 7:50. Choice b keep reason with -니까. Others change relation to contrast (a), concession (c) or condition (d).
